entry.title: Hello, world
entry.content:
Welcome to the blog! Posts live in src/blog/ and are named YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md. Eleventy reads the date from the filename, and the post is published at /posts/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/.

Create a new one with:

pnpm cms new
